sahneler.metin: Near Yarnell, Arizona, a wildfire overran a crew of elite firefighters.
In minutes, nineteen members of the Granite Mountain Hotshots were killed.
Only one member of the crew survived.
He was serving as a lookout elsewhere.
A sudden wind shift turned the fire.
Terrain likely blocked their view of it.
Radio problems left their position unclear.
Their fire shelters couldn't withstand the heat.

aciklama:
Yarnell Hill overran the Granite Mountain Hotshots. The cause: a weather shift intensifying the fire while terrain blocked the crew's view and radios faltered.
